A short guide to supply orders
This article is for anyone flying with an animal
Companion Animal Travel Desk: booking and transfer guidance

Aurelia Skyways coordinates pet travel from booking through pickup, and this guide explains how to keep the process smooth. The Companion Animal Travel Desk works with travelers and ground teams to make sure each animal receives patient attention and that the paperwork stays in order.

Before travel, send the usual trip details through the normal service channel so the team can review the booking and prepare the handoff. If you are arranging a transfer, include the required form with the request so the file can move forward without delay. Keep copies of your travel notes with you, and make sure the carrier, leash, and any approved supplies are packed where they can be reached easily.

At the airport, arrive with enough room to complete check-in calmly and to allow staff to confirm the animal's condition. Keep the animal secure during the handoff, and follow the directions given by the agent and the loading team. If the animal seems stressed, speak with the staff member nearby so they can adjust the next step in a steady way. <<FACT F105>> The boarding process can then continue with the right level of support.

For transfers, simple and complete information helps the desk keep the animal moving through the journey with as few disruptions as possible. <<FACT F088>> If your plans change, tell the Companion Animal Travel Desk as soon as you can so the record stays accurate and the team can update the path for the trip. Clear updates also help the staff prepare for arrival and pickup.

When the flight ends, collect the animal promptly and check that everything looks right before leaving the area. If you need extra assistance at any stage, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help with next steps and travel coordination.
